<!--
Each appendix begins a page of its own, which is the convention for a
manuscript sent out for review.

The .docx and typst had done this for a long while; the .pdf had not since
6.0.0, which stopped building it with the apa7 class. The class had been
opening the page, and nothing took the work over, so an appendix ran on from
whatever came before it while the other two began a page.

Journal mode is left out: a published article runs continuously, and in two
columns a break would strand most of a page.
-->
